title: </sub>  Precommit the matched-control run set
text:
</sub>  Precommit the matched-control run set

When sweep-off controls are run after the published sweep-on results are visible, covering every cohort head still permits outcome-aware run selection: an operator can rerun the stochastic control on all heads and record only a favorable attempt, while the variance clause's “whole set reported” does not require reporting every attempted run. That can reverse recall, variance, or cost conclusions without violating this gate. Fix the control sample count/window before observing control results, or require every attempted run under the matched configuration to enter the evidence.
